name: Cervera del Río Alhama (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally into four bands from the upper hoist to the lower fly, light blue above, then white and green, and brown at the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Cervera del Río Alhama; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: white band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
brown triangle at the lower hoist
